findings.issue: Temporal dependency: tempOpen used before definition
findings.description: The smartPlacementResult memo at line 300 references tempOpen in its dependency array and conditional check, but tempOpen is not defined until line 347. This will cause a ReferenceError at runtime when smartPlacement is true.
The hook is defined in hook/useSmartPlacement.ts but is never imported into index.tsx. The feature cannot function without it.
The memoized calculation always returns the original placement without calling the hook or performing any collision detection logic. The memo should invoke useSmartPlacement and return its result.
The hook calls window.innerWidth and window.innerHeight without checking if window exists, which will cause a ReferenceError in SSR contexts. Add typeof window === 'undefined' guard.

The smartPlacementResult memo runs during render before the tooltip has mounted and measured. tooltipRef.current will be null, so the hook's early-exit check always returns the original placement. Either call the hook later in the lifecycle or measure asynchronously after render.
